snippet.title: Mobile Suit Arena - 2025 RECAP and 2026 PLANS
snippet.description:
Mobile Suit Arena 2025 recap and a look at what’s coming in 2026.

In this video I introduce myself, talk about how the Mobile Suit Arena project started, share a recap of 2025 and explain the main plans for 2026.

Mobile Suit Arena is built to help players test decks, learn the game and play more often - not to replace the official Gundam Card Game or local play.

💻 Play now: https://mobilesuitarena.com
💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/BRMwz2WX3s
📸 Follow: https://instagram.com/mobilesuitarena
❤️ Support on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/Douggodinho
